adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered primary Table 1 activity rows, reconciled linked DBAASP Cyclo(Trp-Pro) MIC/MBC rows to FVII-F2, replaced automated mechanism placeholders with bounded no-direct-mechanism context, and closed the prior analysis rework ticket with cautions.
summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered the gate-blocking activity table and resolved database reconciliation for this paper; remaining limitations are explicit nonblocking cautions about unavailable supplemental S-assets and cyclic-dipeptide normalization.

materials_exhausted.note: Primary XML/PDF and database rows were sufficient for worker-2/4/6 gate repair. Separate S-figure/S-table assets referenced in text were not present locally and are recorded as nonblocking unavailable material.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay/experiment rows for DBAASPN_7131 match primary Table 1 FVII-F2 MIC=16 ug/mL and MBC=32 ug/mL against MRSA ATCC 43300; literature row matches DOI/PMID/PMCID. Cyclic Trp-Pro context is preserved.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary XML/PDF Table 1 was manually parsed into row-level IZ/MIC/MBC records with units, target, method locators, and no-activity rows separated. No toxicity/hemolysis endpoint is reported locally for this paper.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: No direct mechanism assay is available for the SUK 25 fractions or cyclo-(L-Trp-L-Pro); chloramphenicol mechanism is retained only as literature-context discussion.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_gate: The previous rework target is closed because the hard activity-record and database-adjudication blockers are repaired; residual local-material limits are nonblocking cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: FVII-F2 is source-supported as a cyclic diketopiperazine cyclo-(L-Trp-L-Pro), not a conventional linear AMP sequence.
Paper includes active secondary metabolites/fractions and chloramphenicol; final evidence preserves these as reported rather than forcing an AMP-only interpretation.
S-figure/S-table exact assets referenced in text are not present in local OA/supplementary files; source-backed gate values are from main XML/PDF and Table 1.
Mechanism layer is accepted only as bounded context; no direct mechanism assay is promoted.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Local supplementary landing files are publisher HTML/download pages or a duplicate full article PDF; the PMC OA package contains the main NXML/PDF and Fig1-Fig4 only, with no separate S-table/S-figure assets or spreadsheets available locally.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Exact supplemental S-figure/S-table panels cannot be independently curated from local files. The gate-relevant activity/database evidence is still supported by primary XML/PDF Table 1, sections 18/30, and linked DBAASP rows.
